title: Pivot Shift Test

positions.as_written: Start with the knee extended, apply internal rotation and a valgus force, and flex the knee smoothly.
Grade it by whether a glide, a clunk or a gross subluxation is felt, and compare with the other side.
Expect to fail in an awake, apprehensive or acutely injured patient, and do not force it.
A positive test in the absence of a positive Lachman is unusual and should prompt review of both.
The practical conclusion is that an examination under anaesthetic should be performed and recorded whenever a knee is being operated on and the rotational state is relevant, which is most of them.
